content_commit_note: Every capture preserves its actual content/tooling SHA. Current kits reuse unchanged earlier art captures; later source adds Trident range, flame refinements and Troops lighting. A captured revision is never relabeled as HEAD.
coverage_semantics: Each applicability decision applies to all five forms unless an explicit form override is added. Empty before/after lists and absent review_requirements entries mean pending, never passed. Pose sheets do not prove live events or transitions.

Idle.reason: Standing pose is sampled by the shared Animator and the selected kit.

Walk.reason: Locomotion uses the selected kit gait/body plan; hover and tracks remain anatomical movement.

Hit.reason: The existing Hit cue uses play_if_free, so occupied attacks can suppress the reaction.

Death.reason: The existing Death cue owns this one-shot pose and corpse lifetime.

Spawn.reason: The kit supports the spawn pose; gallery sampling is distinct from a live spawn transition.

Evolve.reason: Review the kit flourish on every form; live Evolution plays after replacement, so Base is preview-only.

Victory.reason: P63 resolves the selected kit Victory through Animator::present/celebrate, with bounded root motion.

capture_metadata_contract.artifact_kind: raw_pose_sheet for immutable renderer screenshots; label composed/cropped sheets as derivatives and reference originals.
capture_metadata_contract.duration: Use actual Animator::duration for the selected kit/form, including Victory ownership.
capture_metadata_contract.storage: Ignored local storage or an established external artifact destination; never shipping Shop portraits.
